description: This file implements the SerialWorker class, which manages asynchronous work items with retry logic and exponential backoff, using thread pools and timers.

classes.name: SerialWorker
classes.description: Manages asynchronous execution of work items with retry and backoff logic.

classes.name: SerialWorker::WorkItem
classes.description: Represents a unit of work to be executed by SerialWorker.

methods.name: SerialWorker::WorkNow
methods.description: Triggers immediate execution of work, resetting backoff and canceling retries.

methods.name: SerialWorker::OnDoWorkFinished
methods.description: Callback invoked when work is completed; handles post-work logic.

methods.name: SerialWorker::OnFollowupWorkFinished
methods.description: Handles completion of follow-up work, manages retries and backoff.

methods.name: SerialWorker::RerunWork
methods.description: Re-initiates work immediately, used for retries.
